page_title: UDI 2-0 CAG | Udinese v Cagliari 25/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+3' A bullet header by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
90+3' Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+2' Iker Bravo (Udinese) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90+1' Some patient build-up play from Udinese as they look to unlock the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Razvan Marin is replaced by Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
85' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Christian Kabasele will be replaced by Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese).
85' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hassane Kamara.

85' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
83' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Yellow card. Isaak Toure (Udinese) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
80' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' 2 - 0 That was a nice piece of skill by Keinan Davis (Udinese)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to fire a superb effort that goes into the top right corner. The score is 2:0.
78' Iker Bravo (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
73' Substitution. Rui Modesto (Udinese) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kingsley Ehizibue walks off.
73' Substitution. Tommaso Augello will be replaced by Nadir Zortea (Cagliari).
73' The game has come to an end for Lorenzo Lucca. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Iker Bravo (Udinese).
71' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) replaces Michel Adopo.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Payero departs the field of play to be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) for Roberto Piccoli.
70' Martin Payero (Udinese) brings his opponent down. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
69' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
64' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
64' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
64' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
60' Total attempts – 9:2.
57' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' The resulting corner from Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is cleared by the defence.
55' Martin Payero (Udinese) jumps into a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
52' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Cagliari.
51' Udinese hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

48' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
46' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Keinan Davis (Udinese) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post.
42' The ball possession at the moment is 67:33.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Hassane Kamara gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the right post. 1:0.
37' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Davide Nicola is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Gianluca Gaetano will be replaced by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).

37' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Simone Scuffet is equal to the effort and makes a good save. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' Isaak Toure (Udinese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
31' Martin Payero (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.

30' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Gianluca Manganiello shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
29' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared.

28' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
27' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) heads on.
26' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Jaka Bijol (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Simone Scuffet is equal to it and makes an easy save.
23' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a throw-in.
20' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
16' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

15' Keinan Davis (Udinese) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
12' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Simone Scuffet, who smothers the ball.
9' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to Udinese.
7' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
5' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
4' A crossfield pass from Martin Payero (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Gianluca Manganiello.
